california.authors: Shane Hathaway, Sean B. Menke, David A. Holway
california.transformations: GPS decimal values rounded to six decimal places. Presence cells normalized to present/not-detected; N/A excluded from historical rows. Original/resurvey separated; mixed method codes expanded. No source figures copied.
california.limitations: The appendix presence column combines available resurvey methods, not a method-specific count. Methods differ across original and resurvey work. Absence means not detected, not proven absence. Article Figure 2 caption states 80 additional PLECA sites, while Appendix 2 and Methods state 168; bundled records follow all 168 appendix rows. The exact visit dates are not recorded per row.

coordinateCorrection.policy: Single documented west-sign correction supported by the named Torrey Pines locality; approximate marker, not unqualified published GPS. Original XLSX hashes unchanged.
